role.en: CTO, Baidu; Director, National Engineering Research Center of Deep Learning
role.zh: 百度 CTO；深度学习技术及应用国家工程研究中心主任

why.en: Drove PaddlePaddle, China's first large-scale deep learning platform, and owns the ERNIE model line technically. First ethnic-Chinese president of ACL.
why.zh: 主导了中国最早的大规模深度学习平台飞桨 PaddlePaddle，是文心系列模型的技术负责人。NLP 领域国际学会 ACL 首位华人主席。

title.en: Baidu Create 2026 — the ERNIE 5.1 rollout
title.zh: Create 2026 百度 AI 开发者大会 —— 文心 5.1 全面推出

title.en: LifeMem: Enabling Lifelong Experience Reuse for LLM Agents
title.zh: LifeMem: Enabling Lifelong Experience Reuse for LLM Agents

note.en: Co-authored with NLP researchers from Harbin Institute of Technology and Beijing Institute of Technology, this paper proposes a lifelong memory framework letting LLM agents reuse past experience across tasks.
note.zh: 该论文由王海峰与哈尔滨工业大学、北京理工大学的自然语言处理学者合作完成，提出了一种让LLM智能体在不同任务间复用历史经验的终身记忆框架。

title.en: JarvisGUI: Towards Cross-Device GUI Agents with Dynamic Task Composition
title.zh: JarvisGUI: Towards Cross-Device GUI Agents with Dynamic Task Composition

note.en: JarvisGUI proposes a framework for cross-device GUI agents that dynamically compose tasks across multiple devices and platforms, with Wang Haifeng as senior author.
note.zh: JarvisGUI提出了一种跨设备GUI智能体框架，可在多设备、多平台间动态组合任务，王海峰为资深作者之一。

title.en: Enough is as good as a feast: A Comprehensive Analysis of How Reinforcement Learning Mitigates Task Conflicts in LLMs
title.zh: Enough is as good as a feast: A Comprehensive Analysis of How Reinforcement Learning Mitigates Task Conflicts in LLMs

note.en: An ICLR 2026 paper with his Baidu NLP colleagues analysing why reinforcement learning suffers far less from task conflict than model merging when consolidating specialised LLMs.
note.zh: 与百度自然语言处理团队合著的 ICLR 2026 论文，分析在整合多个专用大模型时，强化学习为何比模型融合更少出现任务冲突。

title.en: PEC-Home: Interpretation of Progressively Elliptical Commands in Smart Homes
title.zh: PEC-Home: Interpretation of Progressively Elliptical Commands in Smart Homes

note.en: An ACL 2026 Findings paper he co-authored on getting smart-home assistants to interpret spoken commands that progressively omit information.
note.zh: 他参与合著的 ACL 2026 Findings 论文，研究智能家居助手如何理解逐渐省略信息的口语指令。

title.en: DocOS: Towards Proactive Document-Guided Actions in GUI Agents
title.zh: DocOS: Towards Proactive Document-Guided Actions in GUI Agents

note.en: A benchmark he co-authored for GUI agents that must search out and follow online documentation to complete unfamiliar tasks.
note.zh: 他参与合著的基准测试，考察图形界面智能体在陌生任务中主动检索并遵循在线文档的能力。

title.en: SimReg: Achieving Higher Performance in the Pretraining via Embedding Similarity Regularization
title.zh: SimReg: Achieving Higher Performance in the Pretraining via Embedding Similarity Regularization

note.en: Work from his PaddlePaddle team on an embedding-similarity regulariser that speeds up LLM pretraining convergence by over 30%.
note.zh: 来自其飞桨团队的研究，提出嵌入相似度正则化方法，将大模型预训练收敛速度提升三成以上。

title.en: Sparse Growing Transformer: Training-Time Sparse Depth Allocation via Progressive Attention Looping
title.zh: Sparse Growing Transformer: Training-Time Sparse Depth Allocation via Progressive Attention Looping

note.en: An ERNIE-team paper on allocating Transformer depth sparsely during training through progressive attention looping, rather than by reusing parameters recursively.
note.zh: 文心团队论文，提出通过渐进式注意力循环在训练阶段稀疏分配 Transformer 深度，而非依赖参数复用的递归执行。

title.en: Emulating Clinician Cognition via Self-Evolving Deep Clinical Research
title.zh: Emulating Clinician Cognition via Self-Evolving Deep Clinical Research

note.en: A Baidu–Renmin University paper on DxEvolve, a self-evolving clinical diagnosis agent that reaches clinician-comparable accuracy on a reader-study subset.
note.zh: 百度与中国人民大学合作论文，提出可自我演进的临床诊断智能体 DxEvolve，在阅片研究子集上达到与临床医生相当的准确率。

title.en: Learning to Generate via Understanding: Understanding-Driven Intrinsic Rewarding for Unified Multimodal Models
title.zh: Learning to Generate via Understanding: Understanding-Driven Intrinsic Rewarding for Unified Multimodal Models

note.en: A CVPR 2026 paper from his group that uses a unified multimodal model's own understanding ability as an intrinsic reward to improve its image generation.
note.zh: 其团队的 CVPR 2026 论文，将统一多模态模型自身的理解能力作为内在奖励，用以提升图像生成质量。

title.en: Mixture of Universal Experts: Scaling Virtual Width via Depth-Width Transformation
title.zh: Mixture of Universal Experts: Scaling Virtual Width via Depth-Width Transformation

note.en: An ERNIE-team paper that scales mixture-of-experts capacity by trading network depth for virtual width instead of enlarging physical dimensions.
note.zh: 文心团队论文，通过深度与宽度的相互转换扩展混合专家模型的虚拟宽度，而非直接增加物理维度。

title.en: Eureka-Audio: Triggering Audio Intelligence in Compact Language Models
title.zh: Eureka-Audio: Triggering Audio Intelligence in Compact Language Models

note.en: Baidu's compact audio language model, which he co-authored, matching models 4 to 18 times larger across audio understanding benchmarks.
note.zh: 他参与合著的百度轻量级音频语言模型，在多项音频理解基准上媲美参数量大 4 至 18 倍的模型。

title.en: RRAttention: Dynamic Block Sparse Attention via Per-Head Round-Robin Shifts for Long-Context Inference
title.zh: RRAttention: Dynamic Block Sparse Attention via Per-Head Round-Robin Shifts for Long-Context Inference

note.en: A PaddlePaddle-team method for long-context inference that shifts sparse attention blocks round-robin across heads to cut the quadratic cost of attention.
note.zh: 飞桨团队提出的长上下文推理方法，在各注意力头之间以轮转方式移动稀疏注意力块，降低注意力的平方级开销。

title.en: ERNIE 5.0 Technical Report
title.zh: ERNIE 5.0 Technical Report

note.en: The ERNIE 5.0 technical report, on which he is first author: Baidu's natively autoregressive foundation model unifying understanding and generation across text, image, video and audio.
note.zh: 文心 5.0 技术报告，他是第一作者：百度原生自回归基础模型，统一文本、图像、视频与音频的理解与生成。

title.en: MEnvAgent: Scalable Polyglot Environment Construction for Verifiable Software Engineering
title.zh: MEnvAgent: Scalable Polyglot Environment Construction for Verifiable Software Engineering

note.en: An ICML 2026 spotlight paper he co-authored on automatically building executable multi-language environments so software-engineering agents can be verified at scale.
note.zh: 他参与合著的 ICML 2026 Spotlight 论文，研究自动构建多语言可执行环境，以便大规模验证软件工程智能体。

title.en: OmegaUse: Building a General-Purpose GUI Agent for Autonomous Task Execution
title.zh: OmegaUse: Building a General-Purpose GUI Agent for Autonomous Task Execution

note.en: Baidu's general-purpose GUI agent for mobile and desktop, co-authored by him, reporting 96.3% on ScreenSpot-V2 and a 79.1% step success rate on AndroidControl.
note.zh: 他参与合著的百度通用图形界面智能体，覆盖手机与桌面平台，在 ScreenSpot-V2 上取得 96.3%，在 AndroidControl 上步骤成功率达 79.1%。

title.en: CORD: Bridging the Audio-Text Reasoning Gap via Weighted On-policy Cross-modal Distillation
title.zh: CORD: Bridging the Audio-Text Reasoning Gap via Weighted On-policy Cross-modal Distillation

note.en: Baidu paper with Wang as senior author proposing weighted on-policy cross-modal distillation to close the audio-text reasoning gap in audio language models.
note.zh: 百度论文（王海峰为末位/资深作者），提出加权同策略跨模态蒸馏方法，缩小音频语言模型中语音与文本之间的推理差距。

title.en: Distributional Clarity: The Hidden Driver of RL-Friendliness in Large Language Models
title.zh: Distributional Clarity: The Hidden Driver of RL-Friendliness in Large Language Models

note.en: A Baidu paper identifying distributional clarity as the property that explains why some model families gain far more from reinforcement learning than others.
note.zh: 百度论文提出以分布清晰度这一性质，解释为何部分模型族能从强化学习中获得远超其他模型的收益。

title.en: VideoAR: Autoregressive Video Generation via Next-Frame & Scale Prediction
title.zh: VideoAR: Autoregressive Video Generation via Next-Frame & Scale Prediction

note.en: An ERNIE-team autoregressive video generator that predicts the next frame and the next scale instead of relying on diffusion or flow matching.
note.zh: 文心团队提出的自回归视频生成模型，以预测下一帧与下一尺度替代扩散或流匹配式生成。

title.en: 631.【BAT播报】对话百度AIG总负责人王海峰：AI时代会产生新巨头
title.zh: 631.【BAT播报】对话百度AIG总负责人王海峰：AI时代会产生新巨头

note.en: Wang Haifeng, head of Baidu's AI Group, discusses in an interview why the AI era will produce new industry giants.
note.zh: 百度AIG总负责人王海峰在访谈中谈AI时代将如何催生新的行业巨头。

title.en: ERNIE 5.1 becomes the first Chinese LLM in the global Search Arena top 5
title.zh: ERNIE 5.1 成为首个进入全球 Search Arena 前五的中国大模型

body.en: Debuted at #4 on the LMArena Search Arena leaderboard with 1,223, behind only two Claude Opus variants and GPT-5.5 Search. A MoE with roughly a third of ERNIE 5.0's total parameters, trained at about 6% of comparable frontier compute cost.
body.zh: 以 1223 分位列 LMArena Search Arena 全球第 4，仅次于两个 Claude Opus 版本与 GPT-5.5 Search。MoE 架构，总参数约为 ERNIE 5.0 的三分之一，训练算力成本约为同级前沿模型的 6%。

title.en: ERNIE 5.0 released — 2.4T parameters, native full-modality
title.zh: 文心 5.0 发布 —— 2.4 万亿参数，原生全模态

body.en: Native full-modality unified modelling across text, image, audio and video.
body.zh: 原生全模态统一建模，覆盖文本、图像、音频与视频。

title.en: 李彦宏卸任百度投资董事 马东敏、王海峰成为新任董事
title.zh: 李彦宏卸任百度投资董事 马东敏、王海峰成为新任董事

body.en: Wang was appointed a director of Baidu's investment arm as Robin Li stepped off that board.
body.zh: 李彦宏卸任百度投资董事，王海峰出任该公司新任董事。
